status: frozen before any window was scored; run_study.py records this file's sha256 in results.json and refuses to run when the frozen inputs differ from the pins below
warmup_rule: every leg (candidate, comparators, incumbents) computes indicators and ATR on the 300 consecutive bars before the window start and scores only the window from a flat book (eval_windows.run_leg warmup_bars); 300 exceeds the largest candidate history requirement (185 rows) and the 200-bar EMA of the momentum_pro incumbent; a missing pre-window bar is an error

cost_model.source: Backtester(platform='hyperliquid') defaults: Hyperliquid taker fee per side and a flat slippage per fill; no separate spread, lot-size or venue-minimum model on the M1 cached path

candle_source: binanceus spot USDT pairs (M1 non-manifest cached path), a proxy for Hyperliquid perpetual prices
funding_source: Hyperliquid fundingHistory, frozen by study chande_momentum_1661
window_notes: The four windows are disjoint. Every window starts after the first Hyperliquid funding rate (2023-05-12), so a held hour without a rate is a coverage defect. The open-ended M1 oos window is pinned to end 2026-10-01. The candles were scored before by study chande_momentum_1661 for a different strategy; this candidate was never scored on them, but the held-out windows are retrospective data, not live forward evidence.
side_population_note: ema_crossover declares short_entries=False and stays long-only; vol_momentum declares short_entries=True and its futures variant ships allow_short=true, so it runs bidirectionally like the candidate

selection_rule.eligible: every symbol leg ran, no leg is funding-incomplete and every leg has at least min_training_positions positions
selection_rule.rank: highest mean drawdown-adjusted return over the three symbol legs, then highest mean Sharpe, then the smallest parameter tuple in grid key order
selection_rule.fallback: seed parameters (candidate) or registry defaults (comparators) when nothing is eligible

verdict_rules.scope: each timeframe group gets its own verdict from the three held-out windows; the study verdict is pass only if both groups pass, fail only if both fail, else inconclusive
verdict_rules.unscorable_window: a held-out window where any candidate, stressed candidate, comparator or incumbent leg is missing or funding-incomplete (unpriced held hours under --funding charge) is unscorable; it cannot support a pass
verdict_rules.entry_cluster: candidate positions in scorable held-out windows, counting entries on the same bar across symbols once

pass_conditions.net_positive_base: summed candidate net PnL after fees and funding over scorable held-out legs > 0
pass_conditions.m1_passes: the M1 incumbent-relative verdict is pass in at least 2 of the 3 held-out windows
pass_conditions.beats_comparators: candidate mean return over scorable held-out legs > each comparator's mean return over the same legs
pass_conditions.not_concentrated: the largest single position is at most 25% of the summed positive position PnL

verdict_rules.fail: entry clusters meet the floor and any pass condition is false on the scorable windows
verdict_rules.inconclusive: entry clusters below the floor, or a condition that cannot be evaluated because a window is unscorable while no condition is false
verdict_rules.edge_effect: pass keeps edge_status no_edge and edge_source unvalidated pending a separate reviewed edge decision; fail records study_fail; inconclusive records study_inconclusive

limitations: Binance US spot candles stand in for Hyperliquid perpetual prices; proxy results cannot establish Hyperliquid profitability.
Costs are the Backtester Hyperliquid taker fee (0.045% per side) and a flat 0.05% slippage per fill; there is no separate spread, lot-size or venue-minimum model on this path.
Funding is charged from frozen Hyperliquid rates (--funding charge); a leg with unpriced held hours is incomplete and cannot count as economic evidence.
